title: Hearty Fried Venezuelan Cornmeal Empanadas
description: A romantic Venezuelan dish featuring cornmeal and deep-fried to a shattering crisp, with a hint of mustard, perfect for a Mediterranean-inspired meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine cornmeal, flour, salt, black pepper, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, proof the yeast by adding it to the warm water and letting it sit for 5 minutes.
Add the yeast mixture to the dry ingredients and stir until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of Dijon mustard in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees.
Fry the empanadas for 2-3 minutes on each side until they are golden brown.
Drain the empanadas on paper towels and serve hot.
